onboarding.languageLead: This language is used for the app interface and for translated mail copies. Application emails are still written in the company's language.

onboarding.localePrepFail: Language pack failed — returning to language selection…
onboarding.localePrepWait0: Large packs take a little longer…
onboarding.welcomeLead: CMAE manages company research, personalized application emails, Gmail drafts, and follow-up tracking in one place.
onboarding.profileWhy: Your name is used in the email body and attachment filename (e.g. First_Last_CV.pdf). You will connect Gmail in the next step.
onboarding.gmailWhy: Tracker reads inbox/sent mail via IMAP and writes application and follow-up drafts to the Gmail Drafts folder. Not your normal password — an App Password is required.
onboarding.gmailGuide0: 2-Step Verification must be enabled on your Google account.
onboarding.gmailGuide2Before: Enter an app name such as
onboarding.gmailGuide3: Copy the generated 16-digit password and paste it below.
onboarding.cursorWhy: Search agents (discovery, research, email writing) and Tracker follow-up / reply drafts run with this key.
onboarding.cursorGuide1Before: Create a new API key (any name, e.g.
onboarding.cursorGuide2: Copy the key and paste it below once — it will then be stored securely.
onboarding.prefsWhy: Follow-up timing and the signature appended exactly at the end of every email.
onboarding.jobWhy: Work type and notice period appear in application / follow-up text. Salary is only used in replies when the other side asks; it is never written into emails on its own.
onboarding.cvWhy: Text is parsed so AI can write personalized emails; the PDF is attached automatically to application and follow-up Gmail drafts. At least one CV is required — you can edit languages/labels later in Settings.
onboarding.bootLead: Gmail IMAP and Cursor API are being tested for real. If either fails, you will return to that step.

tracker.title: Tracker
tracker.subtitle: Track every application here. Drafts land in Gmail; sending is always on you.
tracker.helpBody0: This page merges Gmail application threads with companies you researched under Search into one list.
tracker.helpBody1: Each row is one application process: status, latest activity, and ready actions.
tracker.helpStep0: Run Gmail sync to pull recent mail. On first setup, Hard Sync can scan the last 30 days.
tracker.helpStep1: Companies you research under Search also appear in this list automatically.
tracker.helpStep2: When you need a follow-up, reply, or thank-you, use the action — the draft is written to Gmail Drafts.
tracker.helpStep3: You always send from Gmail yourself; CMAE never sends mail.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Paste company or careers page URLs. Agents find contacts and prepare an outreach draft.
search.helpBody0: Start a company research run with one or more URLs. Each link runs in its own terminal in parallel.
search.helpBody1: Outputs are stored under Folders; strong matches link into Tracker.
search.helpStep0: Paste careers or company URLs into the box (one per line or comma-separated).
search.helpStep1: Start research — agents scan the site, find contacts, and draft mail.
search.helpStep2: Re-open past runs from the history rail on the left.
search.helpStep3: When a run finishes, check Tracker and send the draft from Gmail.

folders.title: Folders
folders.subtitle: Browse research outputs and company files like Finder, and preview what you need.
folders.helpBody0: Each research run creates a company folder under workspace: notes, drafts, and attachments live here.
folders.helpBody1: Use this page to browse without leaving the app, and rename or delete folders when needed.
folders.helpStep0: Pick a company folder from the left tree.
folders.helpStep1: Click a file to preview; markdown and text open in the browser.
folders.helpStep2: You can rename or delete folders — Tracker links stay in sync.
folders.helpStep3: CVs live under cvs/; managing them in Settings is usually easier.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Update your profile, Gmail, Cursor API, and job preferences.
settings.helpBody0: Everything you entered in onboarding lives here. Changes apply to new drafts right away.
settings.helpBody1: Secrets (Gmail App Password, Cursor API Key) are encrypted in the local database on this machine.
settings.helpStep0: Update your name and preferred language under Profile — drafts and AI follow these.
settings.helpStep1: To change Gmail or Cursor credentials, paste a new value; leave blank to keep the current one.
settings.helpStep2: Job preferences (work type, notice, salary) feed application and follow-up copy.
settings.helpStep3: Add PDF CVs to the library; they attach to drafts by language and tags.

settings.dangerWipeHint: Deletes the database, workspace company folders, CVs, and search history. The app returns to onboarding as if freshly installed.
settings.dangerUninstallHint: Removes CMAE from this Mac: all local data under Application Support and the installed app. Your .dmg installer file is not deleted — you can reinstall from it later.
settings.wipeBody: Settings, emails, tracker, CVs, workspace folders, and search history will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.uninstallBody: This removes the app and all of its data on this Mac (database, workspace, settings, CVs). The .dmg file itself is left alone so you can install again later. The app will quit immediately.
settings.uninstalling: Uninstalling… the app will close shortly.
